overview.title: One app. Two powerful automation engines.

about.title: Shared living deserves a clearer system.
about.description: Messzen was created to replace scattered notes, confusing calculations, and repetitive follow-ups with one calm, transparent workspace.
about.approachText: We focus on the practical details that keep a mess community running smoothly every day.
about.simpleText: Important daily actions stay clear for managers and members, without unnecessary complexity.
about.transparentText: Meals, costs, deposits, and bills remain easy to understand and verify.
about.communityText: Every workflow starts with the everyday needs of people who share a home.
about.timeText: Reliable automation reduces repetitive calculations and manual follow-up.
about.whyTitle: One source of truth for the whole mess
about.whyText: When everyone can see the same meal records, expenses, deposits, notices, and bills, daily operations become faster and disagreements become easier to avoid.
about.benefitOne: Clear roles for managers and members
about.benefitThree: Useful on desktop and mobile screens
about.quote: Messzen exists to make the everyday work of shared living more organized, accountable, and peaceful for everyone involved.
